moments.title: Spain Crowned World Champions
moments.blurb: Spain defeated defending champions Argentina 1-0 in extra time on July 19, 2026, to win their second FIFA World Cup title, with the tournament's official anthem 'Dai Dai' by Shakira and Burna Boy reaching number 2 on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: World Cup Aftermath
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the World Cup final? Spain made history with their second title! Who was your player of the tournament?

angles.name: Dai Dai Chart Success
angles.copy: The 2026 World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' by Shakira and Burna Boy hit number 2 on the UK charts! What a summer soundtrack.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will take place on Sunday, August 16, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The new football season officially kicks off on August 16 with the Community Shield in Cardiff! Arsenal vs Man City – who are you backing?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this year! Get ready for a huge day of football as Arsenal take on Man City.

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins on Friday, August 21, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: PL is Back!
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Premier League is back on August 21st! Arsenal kick off the season against Coventry City. Who's winning the title this year?

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: Pre-season is nearly over, the real action starts August 21! What Premier League fixture are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Poole Harbour Festival This Weekend

angles.name: Poole Party
angles.copy: If you're in the South, Poole Harbour Festival is ON this weekend! Who's heading down for some live music and good vibes?

moments.title: Radar Festival in Manchester
moments.blurb: Radar Festival, showcasing progressive and heavy music, is taking place in Manchester from July 31st to August 2nd.

angles.name: Manchester Rocks
angles.copy: Radar Festival is bringing the heavy to Manchester this weekend! Get ready for a huge dose of progressive music.

moments.title: Cambridge Folk Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The renowned Cambridge Folk Festival runs from August 1st to 2nd, bringing a stellar lineup of folk artists to Cherry Hinton Hall.

angles.name: Folk Weekend
angles.copy: The iconic Cambridge Folk Festival kicks off tomorrow! Who's ready for a weekend of incredible live music?

moments.title: Pride On The Park Brighton
moments.blurb: Brighton's Pride On The Park festival takes place this weekend, August 1st-2nd, celebrating diversity with music and community events.

angles.name: Brighton Pride
angles.copy: Brighton is buzzing for Pride On The Park this weekend! Who's heading to celebrate?

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Summer Series
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series in London continues from July 31st to August 16th, featuring artists like Grace Jones, Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and Lenny Kravitz.

angles.name: Legendary Lineup
angles.copy: From Grace Jones to Lenny Kravitz, the Palace Bowl Presents series has an epic lineup through mid-August. Get your tickets!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Out
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 5, 2026, was released yesterday, with 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean holding the top spot.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: The new Official Singles Chart is out! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'. What's your favourite song in the Top 40?

angles.name: Longest Running #1
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is not just #1, it's the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time! A true chart phenomenon.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Robert Cray

angles.name: Blues Icon Bday

moments.title: Happy Birthday James Hetfield

angles.name: Metal Legend Bday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only James Hetfield of Metallica! What's your go-to Metallica anthem?

angles.name: U2 Guitar Legend Bday
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge! His iconic sound has shaped decades of rock music. What's your favourite U2 track?
